worldcombat.skill.dualchop.summary: Raise a hard limb and chop twice from a standstill: the first blow breaks the target's guard and leaves a ground crack, and the second drives into that same crack, tearing deeper if the first landed. Breach style concentrates on one narrow face; split style spreads over a small forward patch.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.0: Plant and chop the same spot twice
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.1: Crack the ground first, then chase the crack on the second chop
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.use.2: Split style chops a small forward patch at once
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.0: Power per chop %1$s (physical), engage range %2$s blocks, chop angle %3$s degrees, up to %4$s targets per cast.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.1: Gap between chops %1$s; once the first lands the second gains up to +%2$s power, and the first shoves the target %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.description.2: The first chop leaves a %1$s-block ground crack that lasts %2$s before the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.breach.on: Breach style now: both chops strike one narrow face and the second tears deeper on the crack; narrow, single-target, with a slightly longer gap and windup.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.breach.off: Split style now: the two chops spread over a small forward patch with a wider angle, can catch several targets and hit slightly harder, but gain no crack bonus.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per chop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per chop is %2$s and the crack bonus rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.growth.2: From level %1$s the power per chop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.preference.br: On (chase the crack): both chops strike one narrow face and the second tears deeper on the crack once the first lands; the cost is a narrow, single-target face, +1 tick gap and a longer aim. Off (split style): the two chops spread over a small forward patch, wider angle, can catch several targets and hit x1.05 each, but gain no crack bonus.
worldcombat.skill.dualchop.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it will not chop and closes in first; this move is short-ranged, so it usually walks into reach.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the two chops finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to chop; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.dualchop.text.breach: Second chop tears along the crack
